title: South Korea’s Kospi index jumps nearly 18% on a surge in chipmaking stocks
description: South Korea’s Kospi index has jumped nearly 18% as artificial intelligence-related stocks bounce back after losses earlier this week. U.S. futures edged higher and oil prices slipped Friday. Shares of South Korean technology giant Samsung Electronics surged 28%, while memory chipmaker SK Hynix soared nearly 30%. The Kospi index had plummeted earlier this week on a sell-off of technology stocks in part over worries about an AI bubble and rising competition from chipmaking rivals in China. Tokyo’s Nikkei 225 climbed 4% and Taiwan's Taiex jumped 8%. On Thursday, Wall Street’s benchmark S&P 500 rose 1.7%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 1.2%. The technology-heavy Nasdaq composite gained 2.8%.
content:
BANGKOK (AP) — South Korea’s Kospi index jumped nearly 18% on Friday, tracking gains on Wall Street as artificial intelligence-related stocks bounced back after losses earlier this week.
